name: Help Desk Ticketing System Workflow

data.label: Ticket Submission
data.description: Initiates the help desk ticketing workflow when a user submits a support request

data.label: Validate Ticket Data
data.description: Validates that all required ticket fields are properly filled out

data.label: Generate Ticket ID
data.script: const ticketId = 'TKT-' + Date.now(); processData.ticketId = ticketId; processData.status = 'New'; processData.createdDate = new Date();
data.description: Generates unique ticket ID and sets initial status

data.label: AI Ticket Categorization
data.prompt: Analyze this support ticket and categorize it. Title: ${processData.title}. Description: ${processData.description}. Return one of: technical, billing, general_inquiry, bug_report

data.label: Determine Priority Level
data.description: Routes ticket based on priority level determination

data.template: URGENT: High priority ticket ${processData.ticketId} requires immediate attention
data.description: Sends immediate notification for high priority tickets

data.label: Route to Queue
data.description: Routes ticket to appropriate support queue based on category

data.label: Assignment Strategy
data.branches: Find available agent and send initial notification
data.description: Parallel processing for agent assignment and initial notifications

data.label: Auto-Assign Agent
data.description: Automatically assigns ticket to least busy available agent in appropriate queue

data.label: Confirmation Email
data.template: Ticket ${processData.ticketId} received. We'll respond within 24 hours.
data.description: Sends confirmation email to ticket submitter

data.label: Agent Work on Ticket
data.instructions: Review ticket, investigate issue, and provide resolution or update status

data.description: Escalates ticket if no action taken within 24 hours

data.label: Resolution Status
data.description: Determines next action based on agent's work result

routing.reasoning: Help desk system requires complex workflow with multiple branching paths (ticket routing, agent assignment, status transitions, escalation). Sequential domain with conditional routing based on category/priority. SQL data model for relational ticket-user-comment structure. Advanced forms needed for ticket submission with validation, file uploads, and conditional fields. Cross-platform mobile support for agents to handle tickets on-the-go. Multiple expert ensemble needed for comprehensive ticketing system.
